translated_title: Graciela Domínguez, Virtual Interim Governor of Sinaloa, Is an Honest Woman, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Graciela Domínguez, virtual gobernadora interina de Sinaloa, es una mujer honesta, dice Sheinbaum
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: The federal deputy, tapped by Sinaloa's Congress to replace Rocha Moya, brings 35 years in politics and a stint as state education secretary to the interim post.
